about: Canmore is a town in Alberta’s Bow Valley, in the Rocky Mountains just east of Banff National Park along the Trans-Canada Highway. Former coal-mining roots give way to outdoor recreation, mountain neighbourhoods, and a busy Main Street serving hikers, skiers, and Banff-bound travellers. About 16,000 people live in Canmore.
